title: 第5章 你们很吵啊第6章 拜神镇天骄
slug: 横推九世诸位女帝一直在等我
content_zh:
场上众人一齐看向来人，眼中神色各异。
这是一位黑衣青年，长相无比俊美，整个人有一种超凡如仙的感觉。
此刻他的神情带着些许凝重。
“李践剑，你这是何意？”狂野星沉声道。
此人是万魔阁神子，虽未曾出手过，但没人敢小看此人，只因，他身具弑仙魔瞳，此瞳凶恶无比，令无数人胆寒。
再就是他出身于凶名赫赫的万魔阁，性格必然邪恶。
但许多人看到他的第一眼都不会感觉他是什么凶恶之人，且不说相貌，就是气质也不像。
但他就是从那个人吃人的万魔阁出身。
作为万魔阁神子，必然会经历无尽厮杀，手中染上无数鲜血。
“诸位！”李践剑看向四周观望之人，沉声道：“我们，有危险了。”
“李兄此言何意？”一道白色身影飘然而落，正是一直在空中观望的白发男子。
“陈兄，此地有诡异。”李践剑开口道。
众人闻言，脸色各异。
叶河看了一眼狂野星，冷哼一声，走到两人身边询问道：“有何诡异？”
四周众人也纷纷围了上来。
看着众人，李践剑凝重道：“此地，被结界封住了。”
“什么？”
狂野星冷哼一声：“怎么可能？若是有结界，那又是谁布下的呢？再说了，就算真有，破了便是。”
李践剑神色莫名：“方才我走到远方被一道屏障拦住了，我尝试破开，发现毫无用处，我又辗转几处尝试出去，无用。”
“我们现在，已经被一道强大的结界封住了，幕后黑手，怕是比之你我，都要强悍。”

这时，方才离开之人纷纷回到了此处，口中骂骂咧咧。
“什么玩意，为啥出不去啊？”
“莫不是我们走错路了？”
“不是，那里我们都试过了，此地好像被一道圆形屏障封住了，任何人都出不去。”
“我靠，谁啊？古帝传承还等着我呢，这可怎么办啊。”
“别说了，我方才看到一株灵药就在我面前，却是碰都碰不到，就连灵力也无法穿透那结界。”
……
听到众人的声音，围在一起的众位禁忌天骄都沉默了下来。
“陈兄，看来你已经知道答案了。”李践剑看向白发男子，神色有些许凝重。
白发男子神情冰冷，眼中有着一丝怒意。
“知道答案？陈北辰，你们俩在打什么哑谜？”狂野星皱起眉头，有些烦躁。
陈北辰望向天际，喃喃道：“他这么自信吗？还是说……他太看不起我等了？”
“他的目的到底是什么？是想把我们都杀了吗？还是想困住我们？”叶河沉声道：“我师尊曾说，他不是现在的我能比拟的，只能暂避锋芒，但他如此行事，岂不犯了众怒？”
“特喵的，你们在打什么哑谜？”狂野星脸色阴沉，愈发不爽。
没有理会狂野星，李践剑在众疑惑的目光中飞向半空，朗声道：
“我不知你的目的是什么，但你若还不解除结界，那就休怪我等不客气了。”
他的声音令人如沐春风，但却带着一丝杀意。
眼见毫无动静，李践剑再次高声道：“忆无情！我知你就在附近，出来一见吧。”
此话一出，下方原本喧闹的众人忽地安静下来，神色各异。
忆无情……一切都是他的手笔吗？

“出来！给个解释！”
content_en:
Everyone on the field looked at the person coming with different expressions in their eyes.
This is a young man dressed in black. He is extremely handsome and has an extraordinary and fairy-like feeling about him.
At this moment, his expression was a little solemn.
"Li Jianjian, what do you mean?" Wild Star said in a deep voice.
This person is the Divine Son of the Ten Thousand Demons Pavilion. Although he has never made a move, no one dares to underestimate this person, just because he possesses the Immortal Killing Demonic Eyes, which are extremely vicious and make countless people tremble with fear.
Furthermore, he was born in the notorious Ten Thousand Demons Pavilion, so his character must be evil.
But when many people see him at first sight, they don't think he is a vicious person. Not to mention his appearance, even his temperament is not similar.
But he was born from the Ten Thousand Demons Pavilion where people cannibalize people.
As the divine son of the Ten Thousand Demons Pavilion, he will inevitably experience endless fighting and his hands will be stained with countless blood.
"Everyone!" Li Jianjian looked at the people watching around him and said in a deep voice, "We are in danger."
"Brother Li, what do you mean by this?" A white figure floated down, it was the white-haired man who had been watching from the sky.
"Brother Chen, there is something strange here." Li Jianjian said.
Hearing this, everyone had different expressions.
Ye He glanced at Wild Star, snorted coldly, walked up to the two of them and asked, "What's weird?"
Everyone around him also gathered around.
Looking at everyone, Li Jianjian said solemnly: "This place is sealed by a barrier."
"What?"
Wild Star snorted coldly: "How is it possible? If there is a barrier, who set it up? Besides, even if it is true, it will only be broken."
Li Jianjian looked inexplicable: "Just now I was blocked by a barrier when I was far away. I tried to break it, but it was useless. I moved around a few times and tried to get out, but it was useless."
"We are now sealed by a powerful barrier. The mastermind behind this is probably stronger than you and me."
At this time, the people who had just left returned here one after another, swearing.
"What the hell? Why can't you get out?"
"Could we be going the wrong way?"
"No, we have tried there. This place seems to be sealed by a circular barrier, and no one can get out."
"Holy crap, who is it? The Ancient Emperor's inheritance is still waiting for me, what can I do?"
"Stop talking, I just saw a spiritual medicine plant right in front of me, but I couldn't touch it. Even the spiritual power couldn't penetrate the barrier."
…
Hearing everyone's voices, the taboo geniuses gathered around fell silent.
"Brother Chen, it seems you already know the answer." Li Jianjian looked at the white-haired man, his expression a little solemn.
The white-haired man looked cold, with a trace of anger in his eyes.
"Know the answer? Chen Beichen, what riddle are you two playing?" Wild Star frowned, a little irritated.
Chen Beichen looked at the sky and murmured: "Is he so confident? Or...does he look down on me too much?"
"What is his purpose? Does he want to kill us all? Or does he want to trap us?" Ye He said solemnly: "My master once said that he is not comparable to me now, so he can only avoid the edge temporarily, but if he acts like this, doesn't he offend the public?"
"Damn it, what riddles are you playing?" Wild Star's face was gloomy, becoming increasingly unhappy.
Ignoring Wild Star, Li Jianjian flew into the air amid everyone's doubtful eyes and said loudly:
"I don't know what your purpose is, but if you still don't lift the barrier, then don't blame me for waiting."
His voice was soothing, but with a hint of murderous intent.
Seeing that there was no movement, Li Jianjian said loudly again: "Yi Wuqing! I know you are nearby, come out and see you."
As soon as these words came out, the noisy people below suddenly became quiet, with different expressions.
Yi Qingqing...Is everything his handiwork?
"Come out! Give me an explanation!"
